Skills.Name: Throwing
Skills.Description: Sure Grip: a physical throw gets one retry after its accuracy roll misses. No extra item or action. Tonics and gas do not use physical accuracy. Ordinary throwing, low-clutter clearance and ground throws remain available without this skill.

Powers.Name: Measured Throw
Powers.Description: Choose a physical item and visible target, then confirm to prepare (one action). The item and target stay selected: confirm again to throw (one action). No wait needed. Gain +4 penetration and cap only if that throw strikes the selected target. Moving, changing the source or another action interrupts. Preparation cooldown 6.

Powers.Name: Driving Throw
Powers.Description: Throw a physical item weighing at least 8. After positive damage and item effects, push the same surviving creature one cell outward if it is still at impact. Braces and obstacles can stop the push. No extra damage or stun; the item lands at impact. Cooldown 12 even on a miss.

Powers.Name: Recovering Step
Powers.Description: Step onto one adjacent physical item you threw, then secure that exact unit without equipping. Normal hazards, capacity and pickup permission apply. Once you step, the action and cooldown are paid even if collection fails. Ground rethrow remains free of a pickup requirement. Cooldown 6.

Powers.Name: Focused Splash
Powers.Description: Choose Broad or Focused while throwing a tonic. Focused narrows the initial splash to one cell, preserving the authored dose and finite matter budget. Multiple occupants there can be affected; secondary reactions can spread. No gas-grenade change. New sessions default to Broad.
